latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Subtitle Video YouTube (v1.0.0).
- Upload YouTube videos and generate accurate captions in multiple languages, with no manual transcription.
- Supports files up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) and exports 1080p MP4 videos.
- Streamlined server-side editing and rendering on GPU nodes; no local installation required.
- Directly handles connection, session, upload, status, and export workflows for fast YouTuber production.
